description: This file defines custom assertion methods for various JSON-related classes, extending the assertion capabilities provided by FEST/AssertJ for the project located in the org.eclipse.ditto.json.assertions package.

classes.name: DittoJsonAssertions
classes.description: A custom assertion class providing static 'assertThat' methods for JSON-related objects, extending FEST assertions to include project-specific JSON assertions.

methods.name: assertThat(JsonValue jsonValue)
methods.description: Returns an assertion object to perform assertions on a JsonValue.

methods.name: assertThat(JsonArray jsonArray)
methods.description: Returns an assertion object to perform assertions on a JsonArray.

methods.name: assertThat(JsonObject jsonObject)
methods.description: Returns an assertion object to perform assertions on a JsonObject.

methods.name: assertThat(JsonPointer jsonPointer)
methods.description: Returns an assertion object to perform assertions on a JsonPointer.
